refreshNotes: 2025 Range Rover Sport carried over the L461 lineup with minor configurator changes. PHEV variants — P460e Dynamic SE and P550e Autobiography — used the same 38.2 kWh battery and ~53 mi EPA EV range as the larger Range Rover sibling. The SV trim (V8 MHEV, 626 hp) opened to a wider order book. P460e Dynamic SE starting MSRP held at $95,100; P550e Autobiography at $118,700. Sources: https://www.edmunds.com/land-rover/range-rover-sport/2025/plug-in-hybrid/
